relation: Core7P-native zero-paid shadow next to forward_shadow_multi_v1 (frozen, only read); writes only v2/
universe: rows of forward_shadow_v1 scores_<D>.parquet minus every code not matching ^(60\d{4}\.SH|00\d{4}\.SZ|30\d{4}\.SZ)$ (scripts/mandate_guard.py), no proxy universe, no switch

signals.core7p_native: scripts/core7p_native_scorer.py: aegis Core7P pillar math (same windows, FWL size+SW1 neutralisation, qarp ep/bp/dy/roe min_valid 2, acc jump/rev_jump/sue/sue_mv with exp(-age/60) decay) with fundamentals from zero_paid_fin_v2; keys CORE_7P_NOCGO_KEYS = [neg_roc_60, neg_roc_20, rpo_clip_60, vpd_20, ivol_60, qarp_pit, acc_pit], min_valid 5 of 7; no parameter tuning
signals.core7p_cgo_missing: diagnostic only, never drives a book: v1 no_cgo behaviour (cgo pillar missing, no substitute, STD keys, min_valid 5)
signals.comp_rank_ew6: forward_shadow_v1 scores_<D> column, not recomputed (reference book only)
signals.rank: pct rank over universe rows with a finite score

documented_discrepancy: v1 no_cgo mode (multi_v1: 'no substitute') keeps cgo as a MISSING pillar (6 pillars); this plan uses the constant CORE_7P_NOCGO_KEYS (neg_roc_20 replaces cgo). Both are computed every night; the Spearman between them and the top-25 overlap are recorded in every decision (scorer.variant_diag). Only core7p_native drives books.

book_rules.pct: kept = held & pct >= 1-hold; size = #(pct >= 1-enter & buyable); fill with the best unheld entry names; equal weight 1/N on every rebalance
book_rules.profit_cap4: descriptive product book (judged=false, no use for statistical judgment): constrained set = names with finite dedt_ttm > 0 and a finite score; ranked by core7p_native; size 25, keep held names ranked <= 75 within the constrained set under the <= 4 names per SW L1 industry cap, fill by rank with <= 4 names per SW L1 industry, equal weight 1/N on rebalance; decision stores the top 400 of the constrained ranking
book_rules.missed_rebalance: a sub-book whose signal night has no decision keeps its old book and is non-official until its next decided rebalance
book_rules.bench_ew: equal weight of universe(D-1), daily, suspended = 0
book_rules.ew6_retain_15_30: reference book recomputed inside v2 from the stored comp_rank_ew6 (no write to multi_v1)

rhythm: 5 staggered sub-books; sub-book k rebalances when (sessions since anchor) % 5 == k; book return = mean of the 5 sub-book daily returns
execution: forward_shadow_v1 D4: T+1 open; buy blocked if not traded or open >= limit-up - 0.001; sell blocked if not traded or open <= limit-down + 0.001 (held, sold at the first sellable open, cash until next rebalance); prices = stk_factor OHLCV first, daily_<d> fills missing codes
official: written before T+1 09:30 Asia/Shanghai with the clock re-read AFTER scoring/product build right before the write; deadline not computable -> false; proxy universe, ex-dividend unavailability, or non-official forward_shadow_v1 record -> false; K-line gate fail -> no decision; fundamentals healthy (qarp_real_dedt_cov >= 0.90 AND acc_real_cov >= 0.90 AND ocf_nonfin_cov >= 0.85) is required for the Core7P books (otherwise non-official, gap reason fin_coverage_low); every decision with a non-official book gets a gaps.jsonl row (late / exdiv_unavailable / non_official_inputs / fin_coverage_low); no decision is written while zero_paid_daily / forward_shadow_v1 run, nor (until deadline - 60 min) while fundamentals are unhealthy
schedule: Hermes weekdays 23:40 --today-session (+ parity of the previous session) after em_ann_store (22:50); 08:40 --prev-session premarket backup; 09:35 --prev-session cutoff; ops/hermes/stock/forward_shadow_v2.sh & forward_shadow_v2_cutoff.sh
continuous_track: all decisions drive the paper portfolio; reported separately; never re-decided

product_file.holdings: daily display target of the profit book: chain over decisions (previous display target kept while ranked <= 75 in the constrained set under the SW1 cap 4, refilled to 25 with the SW1 cap 4); BUY = not in the previous display target, else HOLD. The paper ledger tracks the 5 staggered sub-books of the same rule, so the display is a model target, not one sub-book's executed holdings
product_file.status: degraded when fundamentals coverage is below the official thresholds or a pillar is degraded
product_file.rollback: 60个交易日相对全池累计超额跌破-9%则退回宽基Core7P前30展示; compounded 60-session net (9.6bp) excess of the top25 paper book vs bench_ew; status only (computed and written into the product file: rollback.triggered = true triggers collapsed view + alert banner on #/today), never acted on by code
product_file.retail_friction: 100-share lots, 5 RMB minimum commission, commission 2.5bp + transfer 0.1bp + slippage 10bp, stamp duty 5bp on sells; per account 100000/300000/1000000 RMB: names buyable at 1/N of the account (signal-date close * (1 + 10bp slippage)) and unspent-cash share

evaluation.primary: core7p_native_10_30 - ew6_retain_15_30 daily net (9.6bp), Newey-West t lag 5, official days
evaluation.secondary: core7p_native_10_30 vs bench_ew; profit book vs bench_ew is descriptive only; 15.1bp and 20bp versions
evaluation.futility: at any look from 2027-11-30: t <= -1.0 -> close the book
evaluation.before_first_look: status and counts only (no return statistics printed)
evaluation.warm_up: the first 6 sessions after the anchor are excluded
evaluation.honesty: power is low: sd of the daily-diff series ~8.6%/yr (dev); a true +6%/yr gives expected t ~0.7 after 1 year, so the looks mainly detect harm; passing a boundary early is unlikely

burn_in_for_product_page: 15 valid official sessions (official, no proxy, K-line gate ok, fundamentals healthy, parity Spearman >= 0.999 across full matched universe with top25_overlap == 25) before the product page may drop its research label; never removed by code
